plan_a: Infect combo-aggro: land a single unblockable infect creature (Glistener Elf, Blighted Agent) and kill in one big turn with pump spells (Invigorate, Berserk, Might of Old Krosa, Vines of Vastwood) — 10 poison ends the game, so you often win from nowhere. Protect the creature with Vines/Force of Will and only commit pump when it connects. Brainstorm/Ponder find the pieces. Do NOT overextend into removal; one protected hit is lethal.
plan_b: Red burn: the plan is simple and fast — point every burn spell (Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Lava Spike, Rift Bolt, Fireblast) at the opponent's FACE and deploy one-drops (Goblin Guide, Monastery Swiftspear, Eidolon of the Great Revel) for extra reach. Price of Progress punishes nonbasics. Only kill their creatures if you'd otherwise die. Count lethal every turn; you usually win by turn 4 — race, don't durdle.
